name: Topic Modeling (LDA)
when_to_use: Large set of texts with no prior topic label; complements 21-text-mining-basico/22-tfidf by automatically inferring the latent topics that explain the vocabulary of the documents.
notes: Automatically finds the hidden "topics" in a large set of texts, with no prior label. Applications: discover recurring themes in open-ended survey answers.

expected_input.question: Which latent topics explain a large set of texts, with no prior label?

plain_explanation.purpose: Automatically discovers the subjects that appear in a set of texts.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are many texts and nobody can read them all.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A text column, one document per row, in large volume.
plain_explanation.example: Discover the themes of thousands of complaints.
